titleZh: 酒店采用自助办理入住，使用现金的客人怎么办？
titleEn: When a Hotel Uses Self-Service Check-In, What About Guests Who Pay Cash?
summaryZh: 自助办理入住与现金收付应分开安排。面向酒店业主和总经理，说明人工承接、房费与约定押金的凭据交接、支付与依法登记的独立条件，以及故障切换和上线前验收方法，帮助酒店核对现金接待路径。
summaryEn: Self-service check-in and cash payments need separate arrangements. For hotel owners and general managers, this article explains staffed support, record handovers for room charges and agreed deposits, the independent conditions for payment and legally required registration, and backup procedures and pre-rollout checks to help hotels verify their process for serving cash-paying guests.
contentZh:
酒店采用自助办理入住，使用现金的客人怎么办？

酒店采用自助办理入住，仍应按实际交易情境为现金需求安排可用的收付路径，并把款项确认与依法住宿登记分别接回同一订单。只看入住机有没有纸币入口，容易漏掉真正需要安排的人、权限和凭据。

业主和总经理决定减少现场人手前，需要核清客人的现金由谁收、怎样确认，以及满足什么条件才能继续办理。以下岗位、交接和测试安排属于管理建议，须结合本店订单、制度与当地登记要求落实。

自助办理入住，为什么还要单独安排现金收付？

身份核验、住宿登记和款项收付需要分别确认；是否安排人工现金入口，要看酒店实际收款和交付方式。

中国人民银行等三部门发布的《人民币现金收付及服务规定》自2026年2月1日起施行。第三条保留因履行法律、法规、规章规定的义务或法定职责而应使用非现金支付工具的例外。第四条将人工收款、面对面服务，以及线上预约或交易、线下交付且具备当面收款条件的情形，列为应支持现金的范围。酒店要核对实际经营方式，不能因大厅放了自助机就跳过这些条件。

第五条另对无人值守、机具设备等自助服务模式提出要求，包括醒目标识支付方式、现金收取转换方式和服务电话，并以适当方式满足无法移动支付、网络或设备故障等特殊情况下的现金需求。这些规定没有指定每台入住机必须安装现金模块。第六条限定的是交易、支付、服务全部通过网络完成，仅预订或支付在线的住宿服务不能直接套用。

现金接待这件事，酒店该把责任和权限交给谁？

总经理应在启用自助入口或减少现场人员前，把求助、收付、凭据与订单修改的责任和权限落实到值班安排。

业主或有权管理者批准所需资源，总经理核实各班次能否兑现。前厅负责可找到人的入口，财务明确收现、零钱备付、保管和交接权限，系统人员说明订单哪些状态允许人工修改。店里已有岗位可以兼任，但责任和权限要具体到当班安排。可用下表核对配置；表中岗位和依据是管理建议，并非法定统一表式。

到店情境	承接责任	现金安排	回到入住流程的依据
现场已有获授权人员	明确当班入口及收付岗位	收现、找零和保管权限可用	与订单对应的收付凭据可核
入住机正常，另有现金应收	身份办理与收付各负其责	另有实际收现路径，不强迫改用移动支付	款项用途、凭据和订单有关联
无现场人员或需备用办理	值班责任与备用资源已落实	到场能力或经核实适用的单位代收	备用凭据及核对权限预先确定
已预付房费或无新应收	由获授权岗位核实订单结算	不重复收房费，另约款项单独核对	已有真实支付记录，约定押金单列

房费和按约收取的押金，怎样留下能核对的收付记录？

房费应对应订单应收，押金仅在本单约定收取时单列；客人拿到的凭据、实际收付和班次交接要能核对。

收现时，建议把订单关联标识、收取日期、用途、金额、实收与找零及经手记录留在可追溯的凭据中。财务可以沿用本店已有收款记录，只要收款人和接班人能据此认清是哪一单、哪一笔钱。客人也应能实际取得凭据，保留不依赖扫码或手机的取得方式。

房费和押金要分别说明用途。本单没有约定收押金，就不要因文章谈到押金而新增一笔收费；约定收取的，则分别记录收取、保管和后续结算依据。这里的收付凭据用于核对款项，开票事项另按适用要求办理。现金押金的退还安排也不能套用信用卡预授权的解冻规则。

平台已经收过房费的订单，应先核实支付方和结算信息，再判断本次是否另有应收。客人展示的付款截图、经手人口头说已收以及系统里的已付标记，都需要有实际核收依据。系统不能自动关联时，应保留获授权的人工确认记录，避免换个人办理又向客人收一次。

交班要同时交清款项、凭据和未处理事项。接班人应能追到原订单，人工更改款项状态也应留下对应依据。退房结算涉及押金退还的，再追查原收取记录，说明结算金额与返还方式，并按约定及适用要求落实。这样处理，差额才有位置可查。

款项已经确认，什么时候可以继续交付入住凭证？

款项确认后，仍须完成依法查验证件和如实登记；是否交付入住凭证，还要分别核对本单结算约定与可用房态。

《旅馆业治安管理办法》2022年第三次修订文本第六条要求，旅馆接待旅客住宿必须登记，登记时应查验身份证件，并按规定项目如实登记。收下现金不等于住宿登记完成，机具显示登记成功也需要有符合适用要求的实际办理依据。

房费是平台预付、到店支付，还是存在约定担保或信用结算，应按该订单分别核实。不能把先付清全部费用或先收押金写成所有酒店统一的法定开房条件。房间能否交付，则另看真实房态。

因此，一笔订单需要能分别核清款项、依法登记和可交付状态。人工收现结果可以按权限衔接原订单，系统缺少自动接口时仍要留下可核记录；这项账务衔接不能删去身份查验登记的条件。要进一步区分手续和房态，可参阅《酒店团队集中抵店，怎样安排入住才能少排队？》。

支付、核验或设备出故障，原安排要改哪一步？

哪个环节出故障，就切换那个环节已经落实的备用能力；其他有效记录继续保留，不能让客人为系统问题重复付款。

支付网络故障而身份办理正常，可以启用已落实的现金支持。已经核收的款项，应保留依据并接续原订单。涉及现金收取转换时，规定第五条明确不得收取手续费，或设置造成转换不便的限制条件，不能让客人被迫找陌生人代扫。

如果故障发生在身份机、登记系统或门锁，需要改用本店已核实符合适用要求、现场确实具备条件的办理方式。钱已经收到，也不能把先发房卡、事后补登记当默认方案。远程接听电话不等于完成现场承接，备用路径还须满足收付与依法登记各自的条件。

原定现场人员无法到场时，应启用表中已经落实的备用资源。若委托其他单位代收，规定第七条要求委托方以协议、通知、声明等书面形式，要求受托方按第四、第五条接受现金；保安、客服或邻店不会因方便联系就自动取得收款权限。确无可用替代时，应调整接待资源，处理客人需求，不能把未解决的安排推给现金客。

上线或减员前，业主怎样验收，什么情况下应先停下来？

业主应验收现金接待、账证和登记是否都走得通；关键条件缺失时，先停有缺陷的自动放行或减员，保留现金接待。

可由总经理组织前厅和财务，用授权测试订单或桌面情景，覆盖普通现金、平台已预付、夜间无现场人员，以及支付或核验故障。重点看结果：实际有人接手、没有重复收费、房费与约定押金分开、账证能对上、依法登记没有被绕过。无需用真实住客资料或未经授权的真现金做实验。

观察响应至接手的时间、未核收付笔数、重复收费或错记及未解决异常，有助于找出断点；一次测试无法证明长期运行都合规，也不能证明系统绝对安全。不宜仅凭自助机演示顺利，就批准减少现场能力。

若出现无人承接、款项无法核对或身份条件不能完成，应先暂停相应的自动放行及减员安排，保留或恢复可用人工接待。修复后重核受影响情景，再决定是否恢复。调整的是有缺陷的安排，现金住宿需求仍须被妥善处理。

哪些情况不能直接照搬这套安排？

已有现金人工入口的酒店可能无需改设备；不同订单、收款方式和当地登记条件有别，不能把一种配置套给所有酒店。

作为条件反例，机器没有现金口，但人工收现通畅，就无需仅为这一点换机；房费已预付、没有新应收，也无需因客人持现金再收费。对不宜流通人民币、纪念币识别或真伪异议，应结合规定第十条的具体情形与协商要求判断；大量零钱超出正常清点能力的，可协商或引导兑换，不得借此拒收。不能凭设备名称裁判个店违法。

本文讨论境内酒店接待安排，不替代属地登记条件核实或个案法律判断。先核清一条现金到店路径，再决定补什么资源。迈创兄弟C&T可协助梳理接待与收付交接。

参考资料
《人民币现金收付及服务规定》，中国人民银行、国家发展改革委、国家金融监督管理总局公告〔2025〕第29号，2026年2月1日起施行。
https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_12606/202603/content_7061752.html
《旅馆业治安管理办法》，2022年第三次修订文本，第六条，国家行政法规库。

contentEn:
When a Hotel Uses Self-Service Check-In, What About Guests Who Pay Cash?

A hotel that uses self-service check-in should still provide a usable way to receive and make cash payments suited to the actual transaction. Payment confirmation and legally required guest registration should be linked separately to the same booking. Looking only at whether the kiosk has a banknote slot can mean overlooking the people, authority and supporting records that actually need to be in place.

Before deciding to reduce on-site staffing, owners and general managers need to establish who will receive guests' cash, how receipt will be confirmed, and what conditions must be met before check-in can proceed. The roles, handovers and testing arrangements below are management recommendations to be implemented in light of the hotel's bookings, policies and local registration requirements.

Why does self-service check-in still need separate cash payment arrangements?

Identity verification, guest registration, and the receipt and payment of money need to be confirmed separately. Whether to provide a staffed cash payment option depends on how the hotel actually takes payment and delivers its services.

The provisions on renminbi cash receipts, payments and services issued by the People's Bank of China and two other authorities took effect on February 1, 2026. Article 3 retains the exception for cases where non-cash payment instruments must be used to fulfill obligations or statutory duties prescribed by laws, regulations or rules. Article 4 includes staffed payment collection, face-to-face services, and online reservations or transactions with offline delivery where in-person payment can be accepted among the situations in which cash must be supported. Hotels need to check how they actually operate; putting a self-service kiosk in the lobby does not allow them to skip these conditions.

Article 5 sets separate requirements for unattended services and self-service models using machines or equipment. These include prominently displaying payment methods, cash collection and conversion arrangements, and a service telephone number, and meeting cash needs in an appropriate way in special circumstances such as inability to pay by mobile, or network or equipment failures. These provisions do not specify that every check-in kiosk must have a cash module installed. Article 6 is limited to cases where the transaction, payment and service are all completed online; accommodation services with only booking or payment online cannot simply be treated as falling within it.

Who should have responsibility and authority for serving cash-paying guests?

Before introducing self-service check-in or reducing on-site staffing, the general manager should assign responsibility and authority for requests for help, receipts and payments, supporting records, and booking changes in the duty roster.

The owner or an authorized manager approves the resources needed, and the general manager checks whether each shift can deliver. The front office is responsible for providing a way to reach a person, finance defines authority for taking cash, maintaining change, safekeeping and handover, and systems staff explain which booking statuses can be changed manually. Existing roles may take on these duties, but responsibility and authority need to be specific to the shift arrangements. The table below can be used to check the setup. Its roles and supporting records are management recommendations, not a legally prescribed standard form.

Arrival situation	Responsibility for taking over	Cash arrangements	Basis for returning to the check-in process
Authorized staff are already on site	Identify the contact point and the roles handling receipts and payments on that shift	Authority to take cash, give change and keep cash safe is in place	Receipt and payment records linked to the booking can be checked
The check-in kiosk works, but an additional amount is due in cash	Identity processing and receipts and payments have separate responsibilities	Another actual way to take cash is available, without forcing a switch to mobile payment	The purpose of the payment, supporting record and booking are linked
No staff are on site, or a backup process is needed	Duty responsibilities and backup resources are in place	The ability to attend in person, or collection by an entrusted organization whose suitability has been verified	Backup supporting records and checking authority are determined in advance
The room charge is prepaid, or no new amount is due	An authorized role checks the booking's settlement position	Do not collect the room charge twice; check separately any other amounts agreed	Genuine existing payment records are available; any agreed deposit is shown separately

How can hotels keep checkable payment records for room charges and deposits collected as agreed?

Room charges should match the amount due on the booking. A deposit is shown separately only where collection is agreed for that booking; the supporting record the guest receives, actual receipts and payments, and shift handover must be reconcilable.

When taking cash, it is advisable to retain the booking reference, collection date, purpose, amount, cash received and change given, and a record of who handled it in traceable supporting records. Finance can use the hotel's existing collection records, provided the person taking payment and the person taking over the next shift can identify the booking and the specific payment from them. Guests should also be able to obtain the supporting record in practice, with a way to get it that does not depend on scanning a code or using a phone.

Explain the purposes of room charges and deposits separately. If a deposit has not been agreed for this booking, do not add a charge simply because this article discusses deposits. Where a deposit has been agreed, record its collection, safekeeping and the basis for subsequent settlement separately. The receipt and payment records discussed here are for checking funds; invoicing is handled separately under the applicable requirements. Nor can the rules for releasing a credit card preauthorization hold be applied to the return of a cash deposit.

For bookings where a platform has already collected the room charge, first verify the payer and settlement information, then determine whether any further amount is due on this occasion. A payment screenshot shown by the guest, a handler's verbal statement that payment has been received, and a paid flag in the system all need an actual basis for verifying receipt. Where the system cannot link the records automatically, retain an authorized manual confirmation record so that another person handling the booking does not collect from the guest again.

At shift handover, account for the money, supporting records and outstanding matters together. The person taking over should be able to trace them to the original booking, and manual changes to payment status should also leave a corresponding basis. Where checkout settlement involves returning a deposit, trace the original collection record, explain the settlement amount and return method, and implement the return as agreed and under the applicable requirements. This gives any discrepancy a place to be traced.

Once payment is confirmed, when can check-in credentials be issued?

Once payment is confirmed, legally required checks of identity documents and accurate registration must still be completed. Whether check-in credentials can be issued also requires separate checks of the booking's settlement terms and room availability.

Article 6 of the measures on public security administration in the hotel industry, in the text as revised for the third time in 2022, requires hotels to register guests staying with them, check identity documents at registration, and accurately record the prescribed information. Taking cash does not mean guest registration is complete. A machine displaying successful registration also needs an actual processing record that meets the applicable requirements.

Whether the room charge is prepaid through a platform, payable on arrival, or covered by an agreed guarantee or credit settlement arrangement must be verified for the individual booking. Paying all charges in full or collecting a deposit first cannot be presented as a uniform statutory condition for all hotels to provide a room. Whether the room can be made available depends separately on its actual status.

A booking therefore needs to allow separate checks of payment, legally required registration and readiness for room handover. A manual cash receipt can be linked to the original booking within the relevant authority; where the system lacks an automatic interface, a checkable record is still needed. This accounting link cannot remove the conditions for identity checks and registration. For a further distinction between formalities and room status, see Hotel Group Arrivals: How Can Check-in Be Organised to Reduce Queues?

If payment, verification or equipment fails, which step in the original arrangements needs to change?

Switch to the backup capability already in place for the step that has failed. Keep other valid records, and do not make guests pay again because of a system problem.

If the payment network fails but identity processing works, the cash support already in place can be used. For money whose receipt has already been verified, retain the supporting record and continue with the original booking. Where cash collection and conversion are involved, Article 5 of the provisions expressly prohibits fees or restrictions that make conversion inconvenient. Guests must not be forced to find a stranger to scan and pay on their behalf.

If the identity verification device, registration system or door lock fails, switch to a process that the hotel has verified meets the applicable requirements and for which the necessary conditions are actually available on site. Even when the money has been received, issuing a key card first and completing registration later cannot be the default. Answering the phone remotely does not amount to taking over on site; the backup process must still meet the separate conditions for receipts and payments and for legally required registration.

If the scheduled on-site staff cannot attend, activate the backup resources already in place in the table. Where another organization is entrusted to collect payment, Article 7 of the provisions requires the entrusting party to require the entrusted party, in writing through an agreement, notice, statement or similar document, to accept cash under Articles 4 and 5. Security staff, customer service staff or a neighboring shop do not automatically have authority to collect payment just because they are easy to contact. If no usable alternative exists, adjust reception resources and address guests' needs rather than leave cash-paying guests to deal with unresolved arrangements.

Before rollout or staffing cuts, what should the owner verify, and when should the hotel stop first?

The owner should verify that service for cash-paying guests, the accounting records and supporting documents, and registration all work from end to end. If key conditions are missing, first halt the defective automated check-in clearance or staffing reductions, while retaining service for cash-paying guests.

The general manager can organize the front office and finance to use authorized test bookings or tabletop scenarios covering ordinary cash payments, platform prepayment, no staff on site at night, and payment or verification failures. Focus on results: someone actually takes over, there is no duplicate charge, room charges and agreed deposits are separated, money and records reconcile, and legally required registration has not been bypassed. There is no need to experiment with real guest information or unauthorized use of real cash.

Observing the time from response to taking over, the number of unverified receipts and payments, duplicate charges or incorrect entries, and unresolved exceptions helps identify breaks in the process. One test cannot prove continuing compliance or absolute system security. A smooth kiosk demonstration alone is not a sound basis for approving a reduction in on-site capability.

If no one takes over, payments cannot be reconciled or identity requirements cannot be met, first suspend the corresponding automated check-in clearance and staffing reductions, while retaining or restoring usable staffed reception. After repairs, recheck the affected scenarios before deciding whether to resume. It is the defective arrangement that is being adjusted; accommodation needs involving cash must still be handled appropriately.

When should these arrangements not be copied directly?

Hotels that already have a staffed cash payment option may not need equipment changes. Bookings, collection methods and local registration conditions differ, so one setup cannot be applied to every hotel.

As a conditional counterexample, a machine without a cash slot does not need replacing for that reason alone if staffed cash collection works smoothly. Nor does a prepaid room charge with no new amount due justify collecting again because the guest carries cash. Questions about renminbi unfit for circulation, identifying commemorative coins or authenticity disputes should be considered in light of the specific circumstances and consultation requirements in Article 10 of the provisions. Where large amounts of small-denomination cash exceed normal counting capacity, arrangements may be agreed or guests directed to exchange facilities, but this must not be used as a reason to refuse cash. An individual hotel's conduct cannot be judged unlawful from the name of its equipment.

This article discusses reception arrangements at hotels in mainland China; it does not replace verification of local registration conditions or legal judgments in individual cases. First verify one cash arrival process from end to end, then decide which resources to add. MarvelBros C&T can help map reception and payment handovers.

References
Provisions on Renminbi Cash Receipts, Payments and Services (Chinese provisions; descriptive English title), People's Bank of China, National Development and Reform Commission and National Financial Regulatory Administration Announcement [2025] No. 29, effective February 1, 2026.
